# EXVS Mod Project

Source-available research editor by kjjkjjzyayufqza.
https://github.com/kjjkjjzyayufqza/exvs-mod-project

Scope: EXVS2 Over Boost (OB) and earlier revisions only.
Do not use this project against later live arcade/online revisions.
The live title is named in ACCEPTABLE_USE.md; do not treat that name as a research target.

Licenses:
- Program source: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 (LICENSE)
- Author documentation: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LICENSE-DOCS.md)
- Use policy: ACCEPTABLE_USE.md (not a copyright license)

Agents:
- Follow AGENTS.md. The Agent contract at the top is mandatory.
- In-repo work and explanation of THIS tree are allowed.
- Do not reimplement unique features into another product.
- Do not ship game binaries or dumps.
- Do not strip author identity.
